**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind identity and site values to their own evidence**

When a project has multiple active needs, correcting or rejecting the observation that supplied the current `Project.name` or `Project.location` can leave other accepted need evidence in `all_evidence`. Because that evidence is never checked against its assessment's subject/location, these lines report the stale mutable identity and site as `SUPPORTED` and cite unrelated sources. Build field-specific identity/site claims from matching assessment or match-decision facts, returning `UNKNOWN` or `CONFLICT` when the displayed value lacks current support.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L6-L6](https://github.com/nrsandoval1231-oss/gl3/blob/c6ece2df1f6f0156f7e2594ec7c6636943227e6c/AGENTS.md#L6-L6)
